title: Publication status
body: Switch between published, draft and deleted notices in the header.

title: Create notice or vote
body: Prepare a new announcement for the current community with text, attachments and, when needed, a voting deadline. Save the draft, then publish it from the list when ready.

title: Group notices
body: Read the published group notices and voting proposals. Use their menus to open details, attachments or voting as permitted.

title: Notice actions
body: Open details or vote from the menu. Authorized managers can edit, return a notice to draft, delete it or close voting; critical actions ask for confirmation.

title: Details
body: Read the full announcement, its attachments and any voting information. Opening it is read-only and does not cast a vote.

title: Edit
body: Edit the announcement’s text, attachments and supported voting settings. Save the editor to retain changes; use the list’s publication action when a draft is ready to appear.

title: Return to draft
body: Withdraw this published announcement back to draft after confirmation. It leaves the published list but remains available to its managers for editing.

title: Move to trash
body: Move this announcement to trash after confirming its title. It leaves the current list; use the trash filter if you later need to restore it as a draft.

title: Close voting
body: End this voting round after confirmation, even if its deadline has not yet arrived. The recorded votes form the closed result and no further votes can be submitted.

title: Close
body: Close the voting list and return to the previous screen. Submitted votes and completed publication or closure actions remain recorded.
